actual_scope: For every reached PR2915 high-route Adapter.swap with fixed prime q>2^80, u>=311311, N=d^2>=4, F>=1 and valid distinct route axes, prove the exact PR2899 fitted-B1 caller/callee mapping, complete spectator volume identity, successful-call ownership boundary and conditional uniform tariff transfer.
scope_change_reason: The released PR3301 package explicitly lists the fitted B1 call as its next question. This refines the broad catalogue task to that single source-bound caller/callee implication and keeps PR2899 C0, capacity, GL64 payload and proof-assistant conditions explicit.
bottleneck_link: The merged PR3301 package charges each native B1 interval but leaves the actual fitted endpoint and same-domain tariff conditional. Showing that every reached call matches PR2899 transports its fixed-q tariff into the high-cube invoice under PR2899's inherited C0 premises.
stop_rule: Stop after proving and checking the all-size symbolic call mapping for q>2^80 and u>=311311. Do not claim the q>=3 range, a numerical enclosing capacity, fitted payload execution, interruption recovery, supplier admission, kappa improvement or an unconditional multiplication theorem.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the universal exponent/volume identity and transfers the pinned PR2899 endpoint/cost only under its written C0 hypotheses. The verifier binds the literal PR2915 call path, nested exact-division generator, PR2899 theorem sources and merged PR3301 proof; it checks 972 finite symbolic instances, a Mersenne-127 domain witness and seven rejection controls. Registered normal and optimized replay passes on CPython 3.12.15. No fitted payload is executed.
author: OpenAI Codex (GPT-6) under user direction
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in source analysis, proof writing and verifier implementation. No independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
